_doc: No Law, the night after the murder (#1057; Sean 2026-11-17, decided on #1057 and #1056): Cody's ball leaves Earl down and bleeding, not dead (config/moments/no_law_murder.json `aim`). The barkeep, there being nobody left to fetch, tells Harlan to get him up to Doc's (after.help); you take him up over your shoulder (PlayerCarry: E by him) and carry him out of the yard and up Main Street to the doctor's. He talks while he can (carry.earl). At the doctor's door you bang on it (PlayerKnock: E at the door; ValleyFolk.knocked, the doctor on the book inside hears it). The doctor's up with the sheriff: a voice through the door first (carry.door_wait), then he opens it (ValleyFolk.call_out: his body out of his door), looks at Earl and says he wants burying, not doctoring (carry.door; carry.two or carry.this_one by sheriff.care), and to lay him in the front room (carry.lay). Earl dies by his own wound's clock, on the way or on the step; the doctor's line holds either way. Laid in the front room (carried in and laid down there, or the doctor has him in once you've gone), under a sheet (ValleyFolk.lay_out), he's there in the morning when you go in to the sheriff (SheriffDies: morning.body) till the undertaker takes him after. Won't carry him (proposed, #1057): nobody steps up; he dies on the yard's floor and the morning's body is there.
